senses.sense: (marks the definite direct object — not rendered)
senses.when: before a definite noun that is the object of a verb
senses.note: Grammatical, not lexical. It shows WHICH noun receives the action. English marks this by word order, so it has no word of its own. Rendering it as "the" would be an error.
